description: Walled stone execution yard, open to the sky (39 by 36 m, 6 m walls, four pillars): hard walls give a bright tail (low damping) of medium length; the open top keeps it from building into a hall. The tail sits about 12 dB under a hit (wet/dry energy, tools/audio/arena.py) and has faded 60 dB about 0.7 s after it. A faint flutter echo every 45 ms between the parallel walls; the lowest octaves stay out of the tail (no mud).
